description: This file contains unit tests for version parsing and comparison functions of the OpenClaw project, written using the Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: parseOpenClawVersion
methods.description: Parses version strings into a structured version object with major, minor, patch, revision, and prerelease components.

methods.name: compareOpenClawVersions
methods.description: Compares two version strings to determine which is newer, considering corrections, beta flags, and stable releases.

methods.name: isSameOpenClawStableFamily
methods.description: Checks if two version strings belong to the same stable family, disregarding minor correction versions.

methods.name: shouldWarnOnTouchedVersion
methods.description: Determines if a warning should be issued when a version has been touched/updated, based on their comparison.
